summary: Ecovyst Inc., through wholly owned subsidiaries, filed an 8-K announcing a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of INEOS Calabrian Holdings Corp. and INEOS Calabrian Corporation Canada, Inc. from INEOS Calabrian Holdings Limited and INEOS Calabrian Canada Holdings Limited. The total purchase price is $190 million, subject to customary cash and working capital adjustments. The deal is expected to close in Q2 2026. The registrant is the acquirer. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The agreement includes customary warranties, a warranty and indemnity insurance policy, and English law/ICC arbitration. Watch for regulatory approvals and any bidder financing updates; risk-arb centers on closing condition satisfaction.
